excluded_scope.reason: The release accepts only the canonical Flicky (UE) [!] cartridge image.
The release accepts only the Sega Mega Drive / Genesis cartridge platform.
The relocation build is a controlled regression test, not an accepted output profile.
Source 2.0 verifies one packed-layout regression but does not claim the systematic relocation capability reserved for a later major release.
DATA-002 records that all six streams re-encode to smaller valid streams with identical pixels but not the original run splitting.
The Japanese guide remains editable as raw glyph-index assembly data but is not exposed by Graphics Studio.
Non-animated screen layouts outside the five declared authoring artifacts remain outside the 2.0 editor scope.

delta.summary: flicky.rlj names the game, its kit profile flicky-ue.v1, the revisions it builds and its asset split; the studio views come from the kit's profile.

The editors, their models, the workspace composer, the UI smokes and their tests, Make targets and documentation are removed; editing happens in Retrolarium Studio over hack/<revision>/ (docs/retrolarium.md).
make studio-check: in a throwaway copy the kit prepares, validates and rebuilds every revision with no edits, byte for byte.
The 2.x manifests describe their tags' trees, so their audits run at the tag in a disposable clone; the functional 2.x gate stays on HEAD.
Gens cross-build reproducibility, corrected object and data names, the Z80 sound banks split, refreshed release documentation.
The YM2612 preview renderer and the vendored ymfm leave for Retrolarium Studio; the sequencer fidelity oracle becomes a kit test over make trace-sound.

Six objects are named for what their sprites show: the PAUSE text (was time over), the bonus net (was held chick), the diamond bonus (was star), the chick score popup, PUSH START BUTTON and the logo letters.

AS and p2bin come from Retrolarium Kit's megadrive suite (RLTOOL build-tools path); bin/ is gone, config/toolchain.json pins the kit's files and make verify-toolchain hashes them. AS runs from the project root with AS_MSGPATH beside the assembler.

make lint and make format run Retrolarium Kit's shared linter (rltool lint) over config/lint.json: the AS style for src and the text contract; asm_style.py and its tests move to the kit. The game's source and repository checks stay here.

layout_deviations.reason: The established AS 68000 translation-unit convention uses .s; standalone Z80 translation units use .asm.
layout_deviations.equivalent_control: The manifest names src/main.s, config/linker/rom_layout.json owns its include order, and make verify-layout checks that order against the built image.

layout_deviations.reason: The project uses the Mega Drive-facing term sound for the 68000 host, Z80 driver, music, and SFX ownership boundary.
layout_deviations.equivalent_control: All sound source is contained under src/sound and both Z80 translation units have byte-identity gates.

layout_deviations.reason: The preserved 1.0 workflow extracts private cartridge segments into data/ rather than assets/generated/.
layout_deviations.equivalent_control: The directory is ignored, assets/manifest.json owns every range and hash, make check-assets verifies it, and release-audit checks reachable history for payloads.

layout_deviations.reason: The repository retains a distinct reverse-engineering workflow in addition to build, validation, runtime, and authoring.
